title: vim-companion grammar fixture
description: Keys typed in an editor that starts in Normal mode with nothing pending, and the engine state after each key: mode, pending keys, operator, count and register. Every expected state is written by hand from Vim's documented behaviour, with the generated remaps of spec/generated in place. A step can add the state of one engine where that engine differs from Vim; the difference is a documented deviation backed by a Measured: finding.

start.description: The buffer and cursor that every case starts from, in Normal mode with nothing pending. Lines and columns count from 0; a column counts UTF-16 code units.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique in its file; the global id is <file stem>/<id>.

help.description: The Vim help tags that the expected states rest on, such as motion-count-multiplied.

steps.description: One step per typed key, in order; expect is the state after that key.

afterTimeout.description: Only for a case whose last key leaves a strict prefix of a mapping: the state after the mapping timeout ('timeoutlen' in Vim, vim.timeout in VSCodeVim) has run out with no further key.

engines.description: The state of an engine that differs from expect. A check of that engine uses this state instead of expect.

deviation.description: The finding that documents the difference: what was measured, in which versions, with how many trials.

key.description: One key: a printable ASCII character other than space, or a name from Vim's key notation in angle brackets. A lone < is the less-than key.

mode.description: The major mode. Operator-pending is Normal mode with an operator; mode(1) in Vim reports it as no.

pending.description: The keys of the command that is not complete yet, in typed order; empty when nothing is pending. Keys that only switched the mode, such as v, are not pending.

operator.description: The keys of the pending operator, such as d or g~, or null.

count.description: The count that the pending command uses when it completes, or null when none was typed. Counts typed before and after an operator multiply (motion-count-multiplied).

register.description: The register named with " for the pending command, or null.
